dominant_shape: Motes and streaks accelerate inward while two tilted rune bands orbit the core like a gyroscope and tighten onto it, then a single flash confirms the charge.

beats.name: gather
beats.expect: Motes and streaks appear far out and start moving inward

beats.name: build
beats.expect: Two tilted bands orbit; shells implode onto a growing core

beats.name: tighten
beats.expect: Bands and shells have shrunk close to a bright core

beats.name: release
beats.expect: One white flash with a bloom and an outward shell: the only flash of the effect

beats.name: sparks
beats.expect: Release sparks slow down and cool to blue

beats.name: exit
beats.expect: Only a faint glow, then nothing

layer_plan.name: 0:Gathering motes
layer_plan.primitive: Sprite T_Glow01 motes, eased travel inward
layer_plan.exit: last instances end by absolute frame 80

layer_plan.name: 1:Gathering streaks
layer_plan.exit: last instances end by absolute frame 70

layer_plan.name: 2:Orbit ring A
layer_plan.exit: shrinks and fades by absolute frame 64

layer_plan.name: 3:Orbit ring B
layer_plan.exit: shrinks and fades by absolute frame 64

layer_plan.name: 4:Converging shell
layer_plan.exit: last shell ends by absolute frame 62

layer_plan.name: 5:Core
layer_plan.exit: grows until the release, gone by absolute frame 64

layer_plan.name: 10:Charged sparks
layer_plan.exit: cool and fade by absolute frame 86

acceptance: The build moves inward for about a second before anything flashes
Exactly one release flash, after the build
Bands read as tilted 3D rings, not flat screen hoops
avoid: A flash at the start of the charge
Particles drifting outward during the build
